**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 05:12  
[RELATIONSHIP] Mother is the caregiver of the daughter.  
[FACT] The daughter has a favorite shirt and overalls that are currently soiled.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mother grabs some wipes to clean the daughter up.

[PREFERENCE] The daughter expresses a dislike for taking off her favorite clothes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mother explains to the daughter that the clothes are dirty and need to be changed.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mother puts the dirty diaper and wipes in the toilet.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The daughter mildly protests as she watches her shirt go into the toilet, saying, "No, Mama, not my shirt!"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mother explains that the shirt is covered in "yucky stuff" and needs to be flushed away.  
[PREFERENCE] The daughter protests again, saying she likes her shirt.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The daughter reluctantly waves and says, "Bye bye, shirt."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mother flushes the shirt down the toilet.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The daughter mildly protests again as she watches her overalls go into the toilet, saying, "No, Mama, not my overalls!"  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mother explains that the overalls are also covered in yucky stuff and need to be flushed away.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Mother flushes the overalls down the toilet.
